_what: Privacy-friendly visitor analytics. Nothing is emitted until one of these is filled in, so the site ships with no tracking at all today.
_why: Grant applications ask for reach and engagement. These tools answer that without cookies, without a consent banner, and without sending anything to an ad network.

_pick_one.cloudflare: Free, unlimited. Sign in at dash.cloudflare.com > Analytics > Web Analytics > Add a site (tanitxr.org). It gives you a token; paste it below as cloudflare_token.
_pick_one.goatcounter: Free for non-profits, open source. Sign up at goatcounter.com, pick a code like 'tanitxr', paste it below as goatcounter_code.

_events_we_send: collection_view: someone looked at an object (with its slug)
collection_rotate: someone turned an object with the cursor
collection_share: someone shared an object or their collection
donate_click: someone opened the donate page
